// Makes the fixtures: one JSON file per combination of options, covering every branch of
// src/ai/providers/claude-code.js that changes what the SDK is given.
//   node cap-fixtures.mjs            all of them
//   node cap-fixtures.mjs 02,14      some, by number
import fs from "node:fs";
import { capture, KEYS, SCRATCH } from "./capture-lib.mjs";

const OUT = `${SCRATCH}/fixtures`;
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
const only = process.argv[2] ? process.argv[2].split(",") : null;

// a 1x1 PNG and the smallest thing that looks like a PDF
const PNG = "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==";
const PDF = Buffer.from("%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj<</Type/Catalog>>endobj\ntrailer<</Root 1 0 R>>\n%%EOF\n").toString("base64");
const image = { type: "image", source: { type: "base64", media_type: "image/png", data: PNG } };
const pdf = { type: "document", source: { type: "base64", media_type: "application/pdf", data: PDF } };
const SESSION = "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d";
const planEnv = { CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: KEYS.planToken };

/** A settings store with OpenRouter's attribution set, as Settings > AI would save it. */
const openRouterStore = { get: (k) => ({ "ai.openrouter.appTitle": "My Tarsee", "ai.openrouter.referer": "https://tarsee.example" })[k] ?? null };

    description: "OpenRouter: the bearer token, the tier pins, and the attribution headers (ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS) from Settings.",
    providerId: "openrouter", model: "~anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest",
    runOpts: { systemPrompt: "You are a test.", thinkingSummaries: true }, depsExtra: { store: openRouterStore },
  },
  {
    name: "14-stop-program-keeps-running",
    description: "The caller's signal fires in the middle of a streamed answer and the program does not exit on its own (as the real program does not while a model call is running): what the SDK does to the process, with times. Recorded on Windows.",
    providerId: "claude", model: "sonnet", envExtra: planEnv, mode: "hook", scenario: "hang",

  {
    name: "23-program-exits-0-without-a-word",
    description: "The program exits with code 0 having written nothing on stdout (one line on stderr): the SDK's stream just ends, and Tarsee's engine reports no response, with the tail of stderr.",
    providerId: "claude", model: "sonnet", envExtra: planEnv, scenario: "exit-0",
    runOpts: { systemPrompt: "You are a test." },
  },
  {
    name: "24-program-exits-0-mid-answer",
    description: "The program exits with code 0 after part of an answer and no result message: the SDK's stream just ends, and Tarsee's engine reports that it stopped without finishing.",
    providerId: "claude", model: "sonnet", envExtra: planEnv, scenario: "half",
    runOpts: { systemPrompt: "You are a test." },
  },
];

for (const c of COMBOS) {
  if (only && !only.some((n) => c.name.startsWith(n))) continue;
  const r = await capture(c);
  fs.writeFileSync(`${OUT}/${c.name}.json`, JSON.stringify(r.fixture, null, 2) + "\n");
  const f = r.fixture;
  console.log(`\n=== ${c.name}`);
  console.log("  argv:", JSON.stringify(f.spawn.argv));
  console.log("  env added by sdk:", JSON.stringify(f.env.sdk_changes?.added), "removed:", JSON.stringify(f.env.sdk_changes?.removed));
  console.log("  env values:", JSON.stringify(f.env.received_by_program?.values));
  console.log("  stdin:", (f.stdin || []).map((s) => `${s.t}ms ${s.json ? s.json.type + (s.json.request ? `/${s.json.request.subtype}` : s.json.response ? `/${s.json.response.subtype}` : "") : "text"}(${s.bytes}b)`).join(" | "), "|", JSON.stringify(f.stdin_events));
  if (f.sdk_process_calls) console.log("  process calls:", JSON.stringify(f.sdk_process_calls), "exit:", JSON.stringify(f.child_exit), "abort at", f.abort_at_ms);
  if (f.sdk_error_thrown) console.log("  sdk error:", JSON.stringify(f.sdk_error_thrown));
  console.log("  events:", f.tarsee_events.filter((e) => e.type !== "step").map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join(" ").slice(0, 900));
  console.log("  logs:", f.tarsee_logs.join(" || ").slice(0, 600));
}
